name: Mahlkönig X54
details: Electric flat-burr home grinder with numbered settings.

notes.turkish: Honest Coffee Guide lists no Turkish range.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): espresso 1–8, moka pot 7.5–22, AeroPress 5–35, V60 9.5–24, filter coffee machine 4–34.5, French press 24–35, cold brew 30–35; Turkish N/A. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
